features.name: State, boot and modes
features.acceptance: One source-shaped player/state authority, separated from actor/render resources. Preserve source fresh defaults (brain70, dayTime0.35), distinct new/load/ending/cooking/loading transitions, and ordered startup wake receipt, two posts and ranked news. Fresh/restore invalidate unsafe capabilities while retaining only explicitly documented session-global continuity. Missing/non-array restored hustles reroll at the source start seam; explicit arrays retain normalized contents.

features.name: Movement and physicality
features.source: `core/update.js:updateWorld`; `systems/physicality.js` motion, door-gap, clear-placement and detour functions
features.acceptance: Preserve speed effects, stun/slow, collision on all real architecture, accessible counters/doors and reachable objectives. Convert world relations to metres; validate actual walking paths, not just straight lines.

features.name: Main loop and withdrawal
features.acceptance: One smoke transaction preserves soap-first handling, real rock effects (-50 shakes, -4 brain, +1 cred, lifetime/faction/intro/royal hooks), exact18s high then8s crash and +30 shakes at normal expiry. Hitter remains6s/14s with its separate costs and exclusions; recognition credits the current venue only for normal full-high expiry. Withdrawal uses the documented fixed60Hz adaptation: at shakes100, each quantum rolls0.006 for2HP through normal500ms iframes. The retired slice0.72HP/s expectation drain is not the full runtime.

features.name: Input and interaction arbitration
features.acceptance: Preserve source precedence for Office/hideout/OldSchool/Kingdom doors, campaign and route targets, closest eligible NPC, heist sites, bench/trash/phone/cart/dumpster, zone verbs and finally pocket business. The first-person aim/reach/LOS resolver supplies both E prompt and action. Clear held input at modal/focus boundaries; retain exits, numbered choices, advertised mouse/Space attack, I/Q ledgers, F squint, P feed and global M mute including cooking. Desktop keyboard/mouse native/Web is selected scope; touch controls remain a separate unresolved obligation. Source title shortcuts are replaced by the documented click controls.

features.name: Inventory, equipment, weapons, tools
features.acceptance: Preserve source inventory record identity/quantity, shoes/hat/coat/tool slots, derived HP/speed/cred/charisma/wanted decay, and one selected weapon plus one equipped tool. Only migrated slice junk/food stacks use the documented virtual-unit marker. Torch/crowbar displacement goes to Pete's locker; ownership includes locker while use requires the equipped tool. The arm-only view shows held weapon/tool/coat/shoes where visible; hat/ear/chest route patches remain documented off-camera adaptations. Do not add durability or a generic inventory-use command absent from source.

features.name: Core vendors and economy
features.acceptance: Preserve single/bulk sales, faction rates/refusals, source-specific charisma prices, license plates, stock/locker, loans, hideout offers, counters and quest hooks. Pete's sale-payout ledger caps at$200/day; his source$50 loan is outside that cap, and food remains a fixed$3. Sock-for-$1 is the real source fallback. Yuri copper baseline25 versus Pete15 retains faction modifiers. Ordinary Tony/Pete/Yuri trade remains possible during non-Kingdom bosses; new encounter starts still require atomic boss capability.

features.name: Supply, fencing and cooking economy
features.acceptance: Clean/dirty packet distinction, dirty-first consumption, Barb six packets/day, crossword discount, Pinky alternatives, Stripe loyalty/betrayal and daily fence ladder/cap. Prices quoted through `vendorPrice` have source-specific exceptions; do not apply one universal discount policy.

features.name: Dumpster, trash, pickups and lottery
features.acceptance: Use the real three-options/take-one dumpster transaction with distance-biased equipment/food/packets/weapon/torch/hitter/possum outcomes, cooldowns, trash-can cash/junk/rat branches, tips jars and garbage resets. Preserve actual cash-pile IDs and quest pickups, source lottery offer semantics, and session-global dumpster fresh/load asymmetry. Rehydrate the intro cash pile only while intro is incomplete and uncollected; completing intro alone does not remove an already-present same-session pile. No slice copper pickup or daily reset substitute is a parity rule.

features.name: NPC agency and lifecycle
features.acceptance: Preserve chase, zone-only aggression, patrol/wander, day/night schedules, sleep/shop closure, chatter, companions/allies, essential actors and stable base versus transient/guard/pretender IDs. Current actor snapshots drive original rigs without owning AI/resources/timers. The two source walk-off writers use the documented visible inside-perimeter departure pads, ordinary physical walking and non-reward despawn; no collision bypass. Fresh/load companion and encounter recovery follow their explicit lifecycle adaptations. Rendering an identity alone is insufficient.

features.name: Basic combat
features.acceptance: Preserve source weapons/reach/cooldowns, floor-based14+random*8 base damage with weapon/high/cart/vulnerability modifiers, hit-stun/iframes/knockback, combo rewards/reset, breakable bottles, wanted on peaceful hits, drops and faction/achievement effects. Source Lurch is55HP with permanent death semantics; no slice120HP or daily reward substitute. Retain the shipped ordinary-fists-kill→pipe precedence quirk and the registered atomic Brendan reward repair. Physics owns real swept wall/contact/LOS results; Combat remains the single damage/reward authority.

features.name: Combat archetypes/projectiles
features.acceptance: Preserve charger windup→fixed lunge→vulnerable recovery, grabber stun, bounded swarmer sibling behavior, ranged spacing/aim/throws, Fallen priest phases, default chase and Brendan taser. Actual 3D projectile sweeps and player/actor contact preserve source damage/cooldown eligibility; contact is not a static-wall block. Telegraph/name/health/status presentation uses current snapshots and real occlusion without changing attacks, rewards, timing or AI steps.

features.name: Police, death and arrest
features.acceptance: Preserve wanted0–3,18s decay with equipment modifiers, ordinary/Brendan spawning, radio backup and four-cop cap, dog slowdown and arrest. Death keeps cash/items and live high/crash, sets HP60/shakes30/cred-10 clamped0/wanted0 and returns to Block; arrest removes floor(70%cash) plus real rocks and sets HP40/shakes100. Police removal and encounter abort use the single source authority. Fresh/load ephemeral resets are separate from live death/arrest behavior.

features.name: Tony, co-op and other local bosses
features.acceptance: Tony challenge/offenses, coat phases and Sherri adds; Stripe ally and irreversible co-op choice; older Brutus trigger/phases; fallen priest; old-school encounter and guaranteed first challenge. Rewards and retry/ending state differ. Each real boss must remain defeatable in <90s by a competent player.

features.name: Intro, quests, ranks and achievements
features.acceptance: All24 quest IDs and49 achievements; earn10→Tony→smoke intro, world suppression and one-shot old-save behavior; eight rank thresholds0/10/25/50/100/200/400/800. Rank does not simply recompute downwards when cred falls. Preserve quest flags, offers and alternate completion branches.

features.name: Daily hustles and Block routes
features.acceptance: Fourteen hustle templates use canonical rewards and snapshot progress. Preserve three-stop endless routes, early pool/unlocks/last-stop exclusion, bounded cash/cred, milestones and Office unlock. Route completion including the next route is one transaction. Restore missing/non-array hustles through the existing source-order roll, but preserve an explicit empty array and reject unvalidated saved descriptions/rewards.

features.name: Factions and territory
features.acceptance: Three independent reputations stay clamped-50..50 with hated≤-10, liked≥10 and loved≥25. Preserve action-site price/stock/loan/drop/refusal/ambient effects, territory brain/heat/cash multipliers, greetings and overlapping-zone resolution. Kingdom allegiance remains separate. The documented whole territory tuple resets on3D fresh/load; the border presenter reads it without changing gameplay clocks or inventing a second greeting timer.

features.name: Office, claims and work orders
features.acceptance: Three routes unlock $40+1copper purchase; six upgrades; eleven claims with survey→file→install; faction gate where applicable; rising fee plus1copper; radio/claimed-district work, mutually exclusive active jobs, daily1–3 orders, bounded net payouts, milestone reconciliation. No passive income. Leasing Guy and Gutter Greg remain essential.

features.name: Kingdom and endless succession
features.acceptance: Preserve eligibility from owned Office, four claims and fallen_king; the installed radio accepts summons. Complete nine correction marks across three clan rulers, collect seals, smoke one real Block rock, then Emperor phases and the folding-chair ending. Preserve guarded districts, post-coronation daily paid pretenders, escape/death abort, load demotion to retry and no duplicate boss/guard/add/combo payouts. Source targets stay authoritative while original mounted marks/seal signs adapt to real3D faces.

features.name: Clock, weather, day events and sleeping
features.acceptance: Preserve Day3 visitor, Day7 absolute-wall silence, Day14 inheritance, Day30 irreversible bus choice, every-third-day Price Guy, rent, Mom calls/pass and schedules. Natural, Block, hideout and Office dawn causes retain their distinct effects and strict sleep dayTime>.3 boundary. Gameplay night remains<.25 or>.75, separate from the visual daylight curve. Distinguish active-world, monotonic callback and Unix timestamp clocks; physically blocked conditional spawns/departures defer without rerolls or duplicate rewards.

features.name: Hideouts and shared stash
features.acceptance: Preserve scrap shed ownership, Mom nightly rent/eviction, discrete rest/sleep and the apartment phone's ambient-call delay reset. The shared stash, also used by the Office locker, supports rocks/copper/cash and survives death/arrest. Source items[] has no deposit/withdraw transaction. Owned entry panels expose the same modal actions; canonical wall-less hideouts use the documented nonblocking ground hatches rather than invented interior rooms.

features.name: Cart and bus travel
features.acceptance: Exactly one movable parked/mounted cart supports mount/dismount, equipment-aware capped speed and source contact combat with real physical placement. Pinky/Mom supply the pass; optional travel consumes one pass, once/day, using known/visited destinations and source combat/wanted gates. Preserve380ms ride timing and documented safe-arrival/refund behavior. This service is separate from the irreversible Day30 Bus Driver ending and must not be removed by old no-fast-travel prose.

features.name: Recognition, concessions, discovery
features.acceptance: Four venue ledgers; sit/bother/buy/sell/full_high; tiers3/8/15; visit dedup; no resource rewards. Conceded +night/choir clock/live freed dog/dryer midcycle enables four conditional spots. Discovery changes knowledge only. Clock seeds/phases persist separately from shared RNG. One real smoke transaction; action-time condition check; expiry records current venue.

features.name: Emergency hitter
features.source: `hitter.js`; `update.js` high boundary; dumpster and pocket hooks
features.acceptance: Two copper craft or rare far dumpster find; location-free lowest-priority pocket action;6s high/14s crash, shakes relief20/+35 crash,brain-8; no normal smoke/recognition/royal-static reward. Cannot convert back to copper or create a second permanent smoke loop.

features.name: Robbery
features.acceptance: Only `skid_lurch` landed grab; before damage;60s cooldown/two per day; one bounded cash/item/equipment/hitter loss; quest/progression/tool exemptions and no reclaim payout. Alley Lurch and other grabbers must not inherit this flag.

features.name: Copper sites and break-ins
features.acceptance: One heist engine serves four copper locations sharing3/day and2–4 copper, plus five break-ins with a separate2/day cap and fixed small non-copper/non-rock loot. Tool/cred gates precede charging an attempt. Preserve stage-specific choices, four-pin lockpick, costs/effects order including fatal entry/getaway, no-take paths and exits. Physical entry uses each exact source expanded rectangle and real facade LOS; later modal choices do not invent repeated entry rays. Retain the documented abandoned-building session latch and V8 puzzle-order compatibility. Site residents have canonical dialogue identities without requiring ordinary actor spawns.

features.name: Cooking heat minigame
features.acceptance: Five modes preserve packet gates, dirty-first use, needle/sweet-spot/brain/high effects, source phase overshoot, lock/auto-burn/600ms reveal, bail semantics and six outcomes. Real rocks, inventory soap and smokeable soap-rock counters remain distinct. Presentation renders the actual heat owner; it owns no duplicate timer. Extremely large accepted batches use documented bounded authoritative-RNG chunks with one atomic settlement and deferred lifecycle transitions, without resource caps.

features.name: Other activities
features.acceptance: Eight-step karaoke with forfeit, four-pin reset/brain penalty, market panhandle variants, crate thoughts/sleep, park continuous sit/movement cancel, old-school rip gates, all-cash Price Guy outcomes and departure. A menu with the name but no branches is not completion.

features.name: Communications, Possum and ambient events
features.acceptance: Preserve12 calls, Mom intro/proud paths, ticker, eight-post feed, public-phone ring/window/planted cash,29 world events and garbage truck. Feed/ticker have documented session-global fresh/load continuity and exact silence asymmetries. Possum uses all16 local prophecies and their effects without a network/API-key requirement; the optional source external-host bridge is not required by the approved offline3D scope. Real dog/possum acquisition, release, follow/reveal and shared lockpick use the Companion owner, with documented physical deferral and epoch repairs.

features.name: Living-neighborhood incidents
features.source: `incidents.js` scheduler, required-actor checks, six definitions and actor updates
features.acceptance: Preserve the six source incidents: mattress, possum inventory, laundromat walkout, Yuri receipt, dry park committee and ticketed luggage. One ephemeral scene, three/day, seen mask/history, zone/weather/required actors and combat/script interruption remain authoritative. Retain the one-time14px mattress bump and temporary paper/wet effects; no cash/quest/reward or canonical actor mutation leakage. Physical corridor reservation precedes source choice/commit and may defer the incident without skipping ordinary simulation or rerolling its selected payload.

features.name: HUD, map, guidance and presentation
features.acceptance: Preserve one current BAD IDEA with exact priority/urgency/legal smoke target, I inventory/equipment/lifetime/achievement details, complete Q quest/faction/route/Office/Kingdom/recognition/people-met sections, ticker/feed and the always-visible north-fixed minimap. Source has no separate full-map hotkey or map travel command. Actual projected objective/name/health/telegraph/status cues use safe HUD bounds and occlusion. Original3D weather, wall writing, ownership/Kingdom signs, leash/border, district grade, fixture motion/lights and audio preserve readable information under their documented adaptations. The source known-vendor journal ReferenceError is repaired through live actor ownership.

features.name: Persistence and recovery
features.acceptance: Schema2 preserves canonical durable domain state and stable IDs in a separate3D namespace, with explicit schema1 migration and safe physical placement. Await native/Web storage, expose failures, serialize pending saves and prevent duplicate paid rewards across restore. Reconcile essential actors, campaign witnesses and conditional intro cash; reset unsafe modal/encounter state according to the registered epoch policy. Preserve raw missing-field decisions for wall layouts and hustle fallback while retaining normalized bounded values—never reinsert untrusted arrays or rewards.

features.name: Audio and packaging
features.acceptance: FullScene uses all24 source audio recipes plus the real ambient owner; the original six-sound slice synth stays separate. Preserve actual-input unlock, per-note ready/mute gating, exact source cue parameters/delays and queued wall callbacks across modes/epochs. Document independent cosmetic RNG, eight cached PCM banks and32-voice/256-note bounds; global M includes cooking and the source800ms receipt. Keep pinned Godot4.5.1 Compatibility/single-thread Web, hashed data packs, pointer-lock fallback and isolated native/Web saves. Audible platform behavior, complete progression and the unchanged full-frame budget still require evidence.
